__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="afklow-effort-overview" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>AFK/Low Effort Overview</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel is intended to be used in addition to the AFK and Low Effort guides. It will provide some assumed unlocks, and setup decisions that are omitted from specific guides to increase readability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These guides can often be used for extended sessions if you bring more supplies which is useful for places where you can extend the instance such as GWD2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>DISCLAIMER: IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK </nowiki><ins><nowiki>DO NOT</nowiki></ins><nowiki> MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)</nowiki></strong></p><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>more than likely </nowiki><ins><nowiki>user error</nowiki></ins><nowiki> or </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cutting corners</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki>, use </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki>, and check </nowiki><strong><nowiki>this channel</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if you cannot get it to work</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></blockquote>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="definitions"><ins><nowiki>Definitions</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Within these guides there are two levels of AFK you will see mentioned:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>AFK</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These do not usually require any attention to the game</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may still need to interact infrequently, for example: clicking to prevent lobbying, drinking potions, using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1" alt="enhancedexcalibur" title="enhancedexcalibur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, collecting loot, healing familiars with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alt1 can usually be used to notify you of these</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Low Effort</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These usually do require you to pay attention to the game, and are instead used to heavily reduce inputs required to kill a boss</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In addition to those listed above under AFK, example interactions include: queuing an ability before the fight, repositioning every kill, banking between kills, moving out of the way of mechanics, eating food at low health</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="assumed-setup"><ins><nowiki>Assumed Setup</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Several parts of AFK methods are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>assumed as mandatory</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (i.e., unless stated otherwise these should always be used for the method to work):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Prayers:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split <nowiki>Soul Split</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/T95_prayers <nowiki>T95 prayers</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Perks &amp; Relics:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Basic perks on weapon and armour (see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Persistent_Rage <nowiki>Persistent Rage</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1" alt="persistentrage" title="persistentrage" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Items:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Elder_overload_salve#(6) <nowiki>Elder Overload Salve</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance <nowiki>Powder of penance</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_luck_potion <nowiki>Enhanced luck potion</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717295935500.png?v=1" alt="luckpotion" title="luckpotion" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Other:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/afk/afk-overview/%3Chttps://runescape.wiki/w/Auto-retaliate <nowiki>Auto Retaliate</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_vigour <nowiki>Ring of vigour</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> passive unlocked from the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction <nowiki>Extinction</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness <nowiki>Darkness</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> be active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="common-items"><ins><nowiki>Common Items</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>You may also see the below items commonly used across AFK methods - these are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> assumed by default:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Spring_cleaner <nowiki>Spring Cleaner</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170723130937427.png?v=1" alt="springcleaner" title="springcleaner" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to automatically alch / disassemble drops</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_wrench <nowiki>Holy Wrench</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588922417192.png?v=1" alt="holywrench" title="holywrench" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to boost prayer restoration</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Potion_reservoir <nowiki>Potion Reservoir</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739200407654431.png?v=1" alt="potionreservoir" title="potionreservoir" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to automatically drink potions</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Excalibur <nowiki>Enhanced Excalibur</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1" alt="enhancedexcalibur" title="enhancedexcalibur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to provide free healing every 5 minutes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_elven_ritual_shard <nowiki>Ancient Elven Ritual Shard</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to provide free prayer points every 5 minutes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="top-tips-using-alt1s-afk-warden"><ins><nowiki>Top tips: Using Alt1's AFK Warden</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To set up alt1 AFK Warden you can include several useful warnings.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ HP Alert</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prayer Alert</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Loot Beam</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Inventory Full</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Animate Dead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Overload</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Weapon Poison</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Summoning Familiar HP Alert</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kerapac Kill</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lobby timer</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Depending on the boss you are doing, you can activate different ones of these, and set the HP threshold to a suitable level for the risk of your setup. Doing this will allow you to eat / excal to stop a death.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>You can add all of these by clicking the save icon on alt1, and then importing the following text:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvme/pvme-guides/master/afk/PVME-Alt1-Setup.txt <nowiki>https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvme/pvme-guides/master/afk/PVME-Alt1-Setup.txt</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>

</div>
